objectives.title: Domain Admin
objectives.prompt: Compromise the bufu-sec.local domain, reach Domain Admin and read C:\ctf\flag.txt on dc01.
hints: Users have weak passwords: a first account is one spray away.
Some accounts have an SPN; their tickets can be cracked offline.
Follow the ACL chain from the ordinary users' group upwards (BloodHound shows it).

steps.title: Name the domain
steps.prompt: What is the DNS name of the Active Directory domain?

steps.title: Weak passwords
steps.prompt: Which attack tries one likely password against many accounts to avoid lockouts?

steps.title: Roast a service
steps.prompt: Which attack requests Kerberos service tickets for accounts that have an SPN, then cracks them offline?

steps.title: The chain
steps.prompt: Which permission links each group of the ACL chain to the next? (BloodHound edge name)

steps.title: Get a shell
steps.prompt: Which Windows remote management service (port 5985) gives a shell once you hold a privileged account? (acronym)
